headline: San Francisco Demands Apple and Google Delete AI ‘Nudify’ Apps From App Stores
context: The City Attorney’s Office sent the tech giants cease-and-desist letters this week telling them to stop profiting from 13 “face-swap” apps that are overwhelmingly used to target women and girls.
